title: Year-end Ameyoko · morning kanpai · tonkatsu · Ginza flagships · Tokyo Tower at dusk · Gonpachi farewell · Round1 last night

stops.name: Ameyoko year-end market
stops.plan: Dec 28 is the year-end buying rush: graze breakfast down the alley (fruit skewers, crab, the shouting chocolate stall) and haggle for New Year snacks; split into pairs, meet at Ueno Station's Shinobazu exit.
stops.transport: Walk 2 min up the alley to Daitoryo

stops.name: Ameyoko izakaya strip (Daitoryo)
stops.plan: Ameyoko's open-front motsu-yaki stand pours from 10:00: one round of highballs and a few skewers on the street stools as the year-end crowd surges past (expect 4+4).
stops.price: about ¥1,000 pp for a drink and skewers
stops.transport: Walk to JR Ueno, Keihin-Tohoku line rapid → Akihabara (1 stop), walk to Gabuu; about 24 min door to door

stops.name: Tokyo Tonkatsu Gabuu
stops.plan: Tonkatsu lunch for 8 at the Ueno 1号店 (lunch from 11:30, walk-in; be in line by 11:40 and expect to sit 4+4).
stops.transport: Walk to Akihabara, JR Yamanote line → Yurakucho (about 6 min), walk to Itoya; about 32 min door to door

stops.name: Itoya Ginza
stops.plan: Twelve floors of Japanese stationery: New Year cards, washi and fountain pens as cheap, light souvenirs.
stops.transport: Walk 8 min down Chuo-dori to Ginza Komatsu

stops.name: Dover Street Market Ginza
stops.plan: Six floors of Comme des Garçons, Supreme-adjacent drops and archive labels; the streetwear temple of Ginza.

stops.name: UNIQLO Ginza (12-floor flagship)
stops.plan: The 12-floor global flagship: Japan-only UT collabs and heattech for the flight home; pay per person on your own passport for tax-free.
stops.transport: Tokyo Metro Hibiya line Ginza → Hibiya, Toei Mita line → Onarimon, walk to the Sanmon gate; about 30 min door to door

stops.name: Zōjō-ji + Shiba Park, Tokyo Tower at sunset
stops.plan: Zōjō-ji's great Sanmon gate and the rows of jizō, then Shiba Park for Tokyo Tower against the sunset (about 16:30) and its lights coming on; free, no tower ticket needed.
stops.transport: Walk to Kamiyacho, Tokyo Metro Hibiya line → Roppongi (1 stop), walk 10 min down Gaien-higashi-dori; about 43 min door to door

stops.name: Gonpachi Nishi-Azabu
stops.plan: The 'Kill Bill' izakaya hall: farewell dinner for 8 at one table, booked through the party form or email (online booking takes only up to 7); seats are 2 hours; one bill.
stops.transport: Taxi to DiverCity over the Rainbow Bridge (2 cars, 18 min, about ¥3,500 each); by train it is about 63 min with three changes

stops.name: ROUND1 Stadium DiverCity
stops.plan: The last night: Spocha, bowling, karaoke and the arcade till 3 (deliberate short night #2); passports on you, as Round1 checks age ID.
stops.transport: Taxi home to Garfield House (2 cars, about 26 min, about ¥4,600 each)
